## What changes?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Validation

- [ ] Added or updated meaningful regression coverage, or explained why none is needed.
- [ ] Ran tests, typechecking, package validation, Worker tests, and formatting checks.
- [ ] Updated docs/changelog and converter version if output semantics changed.
- [ ] Included only fixtures/content I have the right to share.
